questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 22 cm and a height of 5 cm. Work through it calmly: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 22 × 5 = 55 cm² — halving is the step that's easy to rush past.
